draft.subject: Following up on yesterday's call
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call yesterday. Two steps usually make the rest click: creating a first project (projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them), and inviting a teammate from Account Settings -> Members. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's helpful, I can walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week -- just say when works.

Best,
Priya
